{"id":"dbb3b2d6-860f-491d-9065-82cdcdccf08f","name":"Special Possibility Tokens","clearanceLevel":"ALPHA","publications":[],"text":"

The color and symbol below represent specific to a cosm. These are only earned during play in that cosm, but may be spent anywhere. Unlike standard , these are only granted for role-playing and choices that reinforces the specific world laws, or as a result of appropriate Cosm cards. Between acts, when you refresh , you may keep the same number of special (up to the maximum refresh) or reset them to standard .\n Aysle: When you spend an Aysle Possibility and the Law of Enchantment triggers, you may choose exactly which item becomes enchanted—including an item beyond the Cosm's Tech Axiom! Magic is fickle and doesn't like to be forced, so there is no minimum 10 result for added dice.

\n"}
